description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump Justifies $2 Billion Made as President With Inaccurate Claims
changes.summary: President Trump has wrongly attributed the $2 billion windfall he gained during his second term to a hot stock market and claimed that he was the only president to donate his salary.

changes.title: Minnesota is pulling troops early from D.C., as pressure grows on Michigan
changes.summary: Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz is pulling his National Guard early from Washington, D.C. as the chorus against Democratic governors sending troops to the city amid President Trump's ongoing deployment grows louder. (Image credit: Joe Raedle).

changes.title: Trump warns Iran "missiles are locked and loaded" if they attempt assassination
changes.summary: President Trump threatened to "decimate and destroy" Iran if they try to assassinate him. This comes as the U.S. and Tehran continue negotiations. Here's what to know about where things stand.

changes.title: Trump and Iran's supreme leader trade threats as mediators try to save their crumbling deal
changes.summary: President Donald Trump overnight made threats on social media of further missile attacks against Iran, after the funeral of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei saw open calls for the U.S. leader's killing.
